opening.argument: The presenter explicitly offers to guide viewers through chatting with support, then describes selecting a security-policy or application category. The visible form presents advertising-related issue options and fields for contact and account details, followed by a conversation labeled “Facebook Business Support.” These are concrete steps in a support-contact demonstration, not evidence of a deceptive financial solicitation. The description also lists an external link, hotline and Zalo contact details, but those details are contextual service promotion alongside the demonstrated workflow; the displayed conversation does not independently verify the account’s authenticity. The speaker further cautions that support is limited, cannot make decisions and may only help if possible. That qualification keeps the guidance from promising a result the video does not establish.
